=== [D1] Fix 2: "Replace with Effect.either" ===

--- file:///.src/matchToResultOrOption_effectfulReferences.ts ---
// @effect-v3
// @effect-diagnostics *:off
// @effect-diagnostics matchToResultOrOption:warning
import { Data, Effect, Either, Option } from "effect"

class UserNotFound extends Data.TaggedError("UserNotFound")<{
  readonly id: string
}> {}

interface User {
  readonly name: string
}

declare const fetchUser: (id: string) => Effect.Effect<User, UserNotFound>
declare const getOption: () => typeof Option
declare const getEither: () => typeof Either
declare const getEffect: () => typeof Effect
declare const record: (value: unknown) => void

// Every handler below reaches the reifying constructors, but evaluating it runs
// other code too. Effect.either and Effect.option would drop that code.

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: Option.none reached through a call in the failure handler body
export const noneThroughCall = Effect.match(fetchUser("u1"), {
  onFailure: () => getOption().none(),
  onSuccess: Option.some
})

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: identity forwarder whose constructor receiver is a call
export const forwarderThroughCall = Effect.match(fetchUser("u1"), {
  onFailure: (e) => getEither().left(e),
  onSuccess: Either.right
})

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: point-free constructor behind a comma expression
export const pointFreeThroughComma = Effect.match(fetchUser("u1"), {
  onFailure: Either.left,
  onSuccess: (record("success"), Either).right
})

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: matchEffect branch whose Effect.succeed receiver is a call
export const succeedThroughCall = Effect.matchEffect(fetchUser("u1"), {
  onFailure: (e) => getEffect().succeed(Either.left(e)),
  onSuccess: (user) => Effect.succeed(Either.right(user))
})

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: map argument whose constructor receiver is a call
export const mapThroughCall = fetchUser("u1").pipe(
  Effect.map(getEither().right),
  Effect.catchAll((e) => Effect.succeed(Either.left(e)))
)

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: catchAll handler whose constructor receiver is a call
export const catchAllThroughCall = fetchUser("u1").pipe(
  Effect.map(Option.some),
  Effect.catchAll(() => Effect.succeed(getOption().none()))
)

// MUST TRIGGER: parenthesized side-effect-free constructor references
export const parenthesizedReferences = Effect.either(fetchUser("u1"))

let moduleReads = 0
const modules = {
  get option(): typeof Option {
    moduleReads++
    return Option
  },
  get either(): typeof Either {
    moduleReads++
    return Either
  },
  get effect(): typeof Effect {
    moduleReads++
    return Effect
  }
}

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: Option.none reached through a getter in the failure handler body
export const noneThroughGetter = Effect.match(fetchUser("u1"), {
  onFailure: () => modules.option.none(),
  onSuccess: Option.some
})

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: point-free constructor reached through a getter
export const pointFreeThroughGetter = Effect.match(fetchUser("u1"), {
  onFailure: modules.either.left,
  onSuccess: Either.right
})

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: catchAll handler whose Effect.succeed is reached through a getter
export const succeedThroughGetter = fetchUser("u1").pipe(
  Effect.map(Either.right),
  Effect.catchAll((e) => modules.effect.succeed(Either.left(e)))
)

// MUST TRIGGER (no fix): the handlers only reify, but the fix would drop the getter in the callee
export const matchThroughGetter = modules.effect.match(fetchUser("u1"), {
  onFailure: Either.left,
  onSuccess: Either.right
})

void moduleReads
